operating_point: Max(group-specific 99.5th percentile) of per-document maximum human window margins from the listed calibration sources, plus 1e-8. No threshold selection on new results.
selection_sources: Prior named external test corpora reclassified as calibration for this model version. The design history and baseline/challenger records remain available.
holdout: native 2021 ANAD news from three prespecified publisher-topic strata, 120 each
published AlpaGasus unreviewed machine-translated prompts and outputs from two prescribed Arabic keyword slices
overlap: Reject any duplicate within these new pools or any sample showing >=20% seven-word shingle containment in one previously examined document; tests fixed prior to new scoring.
endpoints: Inclusive false positives must fall below 1% for each language; report exact one-sided 95% uncertainty; retain at least 50% recall in each machine pool. Word floor unchanged. No always-abstain/always-negative release. No institutional certification from cross-domain data alone.
